questions.question: At a place called Gethsemane, Jesus asked the Father to take the cup from Him. What did He say next?

answers.text: He wanted the Father's will over His own
He would wait until morning for an answer
He would ask Peter to carry it for Him

questions.question: When Jesus returned from praying in Gethsemane, what did He find Peter, James and John doing?
When Judas led a crowd to arrest Jesus, what signal did he give to show which man to arrest?
After Judas and a crowd arrested Jesus, why did Jesus say this had happened?

answers.text: So the Scriptures would be fulfilled
Because Judas had a change of heart
Because the crowd had grown afraid
